what.fr: Nathan Lambert estime que, si Claude Mythos avait été publié par accident en open-weight, le monde aurait été à peu près indemne, avec une accélération plutôt qu'un changement de palier du risque.
what.en: Nathan Lambert argues that if Claude Mythos had been accidentally released as open-weight, the world would have been more or less fine, with an acceleration rather than a step change in risk.

rejected.detail: The quote only says the world would have been more or less fine; the 'acceleration rather than a step change in risk' part is not in the quote.

what.fr: Epoch AI a utilisé GLM 5.3 pour créer un site web qui, dès qu'un utilisateur de Firefox le visite et sans autre interaction, permettait à l'attaquant d'exfiltrer des fichiers de l'ordinateur de l'util
what.en: Epoch AI used GLM 5.3 to create a website that, simply when visited by a Firefox user and without further interaction, let the attacker exfiltrate files from the user's computer.

rejected.detail: The quote says 'We used GLM 5.3', but nothing in it identifies the speaker as Epoch AI; the attribution is not established by the quote alone.

what.fr: Cursor a retiré la version compromise de la place de marché et bloqué sa distribution ultérieure.
what.en: Cursor removed the backdoored version from the marketplace and blocked further distribution.

rejected.detail: The quote says 'Personnel' removed the version, and nothing in it identifies Cursor as the actor.

what.fr: Microsoft a généré trois environnements d'entreprise synthétiques couvrant plusieurs secteurs pour évaluer Copilot.
what.en: Microsoft generated three synthetic enterprise environments across multiple industries to evaluate Copilot.

rejected.detail: The quote does not mention Microsoft or Copilot evaluation explicitly; it only says three synthetic environments were generated across industries.

what.fr: Le score de qualité composite des données synthétiques a progressé de 39 % par rapport à l'approche de génération initiale.
what.en: The composite quality score of the synthetic data improved 39% compared to the initial generation approach.

rejected.detail: The quote says 'scores improved 39%' without stating it is the composite quality score of the synthetic data.

what.fr: La plateforme a été publiée dans un catalogue interne partagé et érigée en première référence d'évaluation standardisée pour Microsoft Copilot.
what.en: The platform was published to an internal shared catalog and established as the first standardized evaluation baseline for Microsoft Copilot.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say what was published; 'the platform' is not established, and the quote refers to unspecified items.
